scope: Exactly the intended new task payload plus changed shared catalog/manifest; detached receipts scanned separately after creation. No historical repository-wide secret scan.
included: Reports, validator and diff, offline helpers/controls, selected already-indexed raw inputs, relevant preservation and instruction identity metadata, commands and failed attempts
excluded: Private browser profiles, Skill/Memory contents, credentials, unrelated inventories, environments, product source/build duplicates
redaction: Local path aliases only. Selection/event/identity values unchanged. Byte-exact and redacted hashes distinguished in INDEX.json.
scan_receipt: Final file-list/hash coverage and match counts recorded in detached post-push receipt.
